summary: This topic describes how to modify the details of an existing inventory item within the system. Users can either directly select an item for editing or use a search function to locate it.
steps: Navigate to the Item Masters section.
Click 'Edit' for the desired existing item.
Alternatively, use the search function to find the item and then click 'Edit'.
Modify the necessary fields (e.g., item name, item group, unit).
important_notes: Ensure all modifications are accurate before saving to maintain data integrity.
questions: How do I modify the details of an existing inventory item?
Can I search for an item before editing it?
What fields can be updated for an existing item?
